translationRepairs: After the Wuchang uprising Suzhou seceded. Governor Zhang Renjun and General Tie Liangfang met with their officials to debate whether to fight or hold out, and Zhang Xun sharply denounced anyone who dissented.

After the Wuchang uprising Suzhou seceded. Governor Zhang Renjun and General Tie Liang met with their officials to debate whether to fight or hold out, and Zhang Xun sharply denounced anyone who dissented.
s0010 has 將軍鐵良方與眾籌戰守: 鐵良 is the general's name and 方 is the adverb 'just then,' so fused English Tie Liangfang is wrong; the proposed Tie Liang is accurate.

When the Wuchang revolt erupted and Suzhou declared independence, Governor Zhang Renjun and General Tie Liangfang discussed war and defense with the assembly; when someone disagreed, Zhang Xun rebuked him outright.

When the Wuchang revolt erupted and Suzhou declared independence, Governor Zhang Renjun and General Tie Liang discussed war and defense with the assembly; when someone disagreed, Zhang Xun rebuked him outright.
The same phrase 將軍鐵良方 shows Tie Liang plus adverb 方, not a personal name Tie Liangfang; the literal replacement correctly separates them.

When the orders were issued, most provinces did not respond; then Duan Qirui's army rose at Mafang, styled itself the army to suppress rebellion, and issued a proclamation against Zhang Xun; Zhang asked to be dismissed.

When the orders were issued, most provinces did not respond; then the army at Machang rose, styled itself the army to suppress rebellion, and issued a proclamation against Zhang Xun; Zhang asked to be dismissed.
s0060 has 馬廠師起 with no personal name; the original invents Duan Qirui and misreads 馬廠 as Mafang, while Machang and omitting the invented name restore the Chinese.

In youth he studied under Zhu Ciqian, mastered the classics and histories broadly, favored the Gongyang school, spoke of Confucius's institutional reforms, advocated dating by Confucius's era, honored Confucius and protected the teaching, and first gathered disciples to lecture.

In youth he studied under Zhu Ciqi, mastered the classics and histories broadly, favored the Gongyang school, spoke of Confucius's institutional reforms, advocated dating by Confucius's era, honored Confucius and protected the teaching, and first gathered disciples to lecture.
s0068 has 硃次琦; 琦 is qi, so Zhu Ciqi is correct and Ciqian is a misreading of the final character.

Offices were appointed in succession: Zhang Xun and Chen Baochen, Liu Tingchen, and others as cabinet deliberative ministers; next, cabinet vice directors Wan Shengqi and Hu Siyuan; grand secretaries Qu Hongji and Sheng Yun; advisory ministers Zhao Erxun, Chen Kuilong, Zhang Yinglin, Feng Xu, and others; ministers of the various boards Liang Dunyan, Zhang Zhenfang, Lei Zhenchun, Shen Zengzhi, Lao Naixuan, and others; vice ministers Li Jingmai, Li Ruiqing, Chen Zengshou, Wang Naizheng, Chen Yi, Gu Yuan, and others; assistant councillors Gu Tangsheng, Zhang Kun, Li Zhanzhi, Liang Yonghu, and others; censor-in-chief Zhang Ceng'e; vice censor-in-chief Hu Sijing and Wen Su;

Offices were appointed in succession: Zhang Xun and Chen Baochen, Liu Tingchen, and others as cabinet deliberative ministers; next, cabinet vice directors Wan Shengqi and Hu Siyuan; grand secretaries Qu Hongji and Sheng Yun; advisory ministers Zhao Erxun, Chen Kuilong, Zhang Yinglin, Feng Xu, and others; ministers of the various boards Liang Dunyan, Zhang Zhenfang, Lei Zhenchun, Shen Zengzhi, Lao Naixuan, and others; vice ministers Li Jingmai, Li Ruiqing, Chen Zengshou, Wang Naizheng, Chen Yi, Gu Yuan, and others; assistant councillors Gu Tangsheng, Zhang Qin, Li Zhanzhi, Liang Yonghu, and others; censor-in-chief Zhang Ceng'e; vice censor-in-chief Hu Sijing and Wen Su;
s0056 lists 章梫 among the 丞參; 梫 is Qin, so Zhang Qin is correct and Kun does not match the character.

The following year, when the court moved to Tianjin, Kang came to audience and audience, urging the emperor to advance in virtue, cultivate learning, draw near the worthy, and keep the crafty at a distance.
The following year, when the court moved to Tianjin, Kang came to audience, urging the emperor to advance in virtue, cultivate learning, draw near the worthy, and keep the crafty at a distance.
s0108 has 有為來覲謁 once; 'audience and audience' is an unsupported English duplication, and the proposed single 'audience' matches the Chinese.

The next year, when the court moved to Tianjin, Kang came to audience and audience, speaking of advancing in virtue, cultivating learning, drawing near the worthy, and keeping the crafty at a distance.
The next year, when the court moved to Tianjin, Kang came to audience, speaking of advancing in virtue, cultivating learning, drawing near the worthy, and keeping the crafty at a distance.
The literal likewise doubles 'audience' against single 覲謁; removing the duplicate restores fidelity without other change.
